status_rule: STABLE when no findings or confidence below min_confidence; OUTLIER when confidence >= outlier_threshold and at least one hard feature remains; else REVIEW

encoding.determinism: byte-identical /app/build/pairing_class_report.json across repeated make run on unchanged fixtures; sort map keys before ranging on every path that affects findings corrections or coupling order including policy override resolution

policy_resolution: defaults then top-level case fields then policy_overrides via ResolveCase and ResolveConfidence; only JSON numbers and booleans apply; string overrides are inert; soft_dampen_pct zero is a valid numeric override and must replace the default; policy_overrides must honor min_confidence soft_dampen_pct outlier_threshold max_fanout_depth and max_chain_depth

declared_vs_observed.undeclared_coupling: OBSERVE_COUPLING with no DECLARE_COUPLING for same sink_id and source_id
declared_vs_observed.stale_coupling: DECLARE_COUPLING with no OBSERVE_COUPLING for same sink_id and source_id when emit_stale_couplings true
declared_vs_observed.channel_drift: matching pair where declare channel differs from observe channel; detail format is declare>observe with a literal greater-than between channel names
declared_vs_observed.flux_starve: WEIGHT_STARVE when required declared coupling has observe weight equal to zero; entity_id sink_id; detail source_id; event_seq is observe seq; correction BOOST_FLUX

live_observed_graph.cycle_edges: CYCLE_DETECTED uses every observed coupling including weight zero
live_observed_graph.mutual_and_fanout_edges: mutual pairing and fanout reverse BFS use only observed couplings with weight strictly greater than zero
live_observed_graph.rule: cycle graph and live graph are intentionally different edge sets

cycle_detected.search: strongly connected components on all observed directed couplings including zero-weight; emit only when the extracted cycle has at least three distinct sites; two-site loops are not CYCLE_DETECTED
cycle_detected.detail: lexicographically smallest rotation of cycle joined with greater-than sign including return to start
cycle_detected.entity_id: first site in the rotated cycle detail before the first greater-than
cycle_detected.event_seq: audit_seq equals max event seq plus one

mutual_coupling.rule: when score_mutual_couplings true and live observed couplings exist in both directions between A and B with weight strictly greater than zero each way
mutual_coupling.suppress_when: omit MUTUAL_COUPLING when both sites appear in any CYCLE_DETECTED detail; a site appearing alone in a cycle does not suppress

fanout_and_failure.fanout_depth: from each INJECT_FAILURE site BFS on the reverse of weight-greater-than-zero observed couplings only; zero-weight observed edges are absent so they cut reverse paths; emit when max hop is strictly greater than max_fanout_depth
fanout_and_failure.required_unreachable: after removing failed sites if seed is set and a required declared source is unreachable from seed via remaining declared couplings
fanout_and_failure.seed_unreachable: critical site with no path from seed on all declared couplings
fanout_and_failure.depth_exceeded: longest simple path from seed on required declared couplings only; optional declared edges never lengthen depth; emit when depth is strictly greater than max_chain_depth

post_audit.orphan_site: registered site that never appears as sink or source in any declare or observe coupling emit once at audit_seq

finding_id.format: case_id double colon entity_id double colon event_seq as four decimal digits
finding_id.never_include: kind or detail must not appear inside finding_id
finding_id.event_seq_source: seq field of the triggering replay event not replay index; post-audit findings use audit_seq

correction_id.format: case_id double colon action double colon target_id

mapping.CYCLE_DETECTED: BREAK_CYCLE target cycle entity_id detail full cycle string
mapping.FANOUT_DEPTH: SHIELD_SITE target failed site_id detail hop count as decimal
mapping.SEED_UNREACHABLE: REROUTE_PATH target critical site_id detail seed_id

finding_entity_detail.UNDECLARED_COUPLING: entity_id is sink_id; detail is source_id
finding_entity_detail.STALE_COUPLING: entity_id is sink_id; detail is source_id
finding_entity_detail.CHANNEL_DRIFT: entity_id is sink_id; detail is declare_channel greater-than observe_channel
finding_entity_detail.WEIGHT_STARVE: entity_id is sink_id; detail is source_id
finding_entity_detail.MISSING_SITE: entity_id is missing site_id; detail is event kind
finding_entity_detail.CYCLE_DETECTED: entity_id is first node of rotated cycle; detail is full cycle string
finding_entity_detail.MUTUAL_COUPLING: entity_id is smaller site_id; detail is larger site_id
finding_entity_detail.ORPHAN_SITE: entity_id is site_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.DUPLICATE_SITE: entity_id is site_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.UNKNOWN_SINK: entity_id is sink_id; detail is source_id
finding_entity_detail.SEED_UNREACHABLE: entity_id is critical site_id; detail is seed_id
finding_entity_detail.DEPTH_EXCEEDED: entity_id is deepest site_id; detail is depth as decimal
finding_entity_detail.FANOUT_DEPTH: entity_id is failed site_id; detail is max hop reached as decimal
finding_entity_detail.REQUIRED_UNREACHABLE: entity_id is unreachable required source_id; detail is seed_id

evidence_stack_bonus.count: distinct hard kinds not raw finding count

confidence.hard_sum: sum feature_weights of hard findings at full value
confidence.soft_sum: sum feature_weights of soft findings then multiply by soft_dampen_pct and integer divide by 100; never dampen hard weights
confidence.combo: after base add combo_bonus.points when both CHANNEL_DRIFT and WEIGHT_STARVE present
confidence.evidence_stack: after combo add evidence_stack_bonus.points when distinct hard kinds is at least evidence_stack_bonus.min_hard
confidence.mixed_tax: after evidence_stack subtract mixed_evidence_tax.points when hardCount>=1 and softCount>=1 using finding counts not dampened sums; soft_dampen_pct zero still taxes
confidence.cap: clamp confidence to 100 after bonuses and tax; never below 0

verdict_rule.fp_suppress: if confidence less than min_confidence set confidence 0 and status STABLE; retain findings for feature audit
verdict_rule.stable: no findings or after fp suppress
verdict_rule.outlier: confidence greater than or equal to outlier_threshold AND at least one hard finding kind remains; soft only never OUTLIER even when confidence is at or above outlier_threshold
